id: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace (1999)

facts.text: Patience, Anakin. Eat your fill tonight, the trip to Coruscant is a long one.
facts.why: Qui-Gon never says this. His real lines include 'There's always a bigger fish' and 'Be mindful of the living Force, young Padawan.'

vibe.verdict: Watto's shop sign and the bigger fish note print, but the Jar Jar and bad feeling winks are dropped and the board is just dish names.
missing: I have a bad feeling about this (Obi-Wan)

Replace the 'Mos Espa pear, nectarine and feta platter' note with Watto: 'No money! No parts! No deal!'
Swap the 'Theed palace fennel pork' note for Qui-Gon: 'Be mindful of the living Force.'
